compiled_state.title: Replay-based regression harness placeholder: prompt/model drift detection on labeled corpus
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Context (placeholder)

Replay-based regression test harness for the LLM code review pipeline. Once the central telemetry store (Epic e7f3-2b45-8d7d-4c68 umbrella) has accumulated arbiter-labeled findings, those labels function as ground truth for prompt/model regression testing.

## Scope (to be brainstormed)

Fetch labeled PRs from the central store; re-run the reviewer prompt against the same diff; score finding-set agreement against the historical arbiter ruling. Surface regressions on prompt edits, model upgrades, or reviewer-base.md changes. Becomes the third leg of Gap 3 (corpus + telemetry consumer + regression harness) after the umbrella ships the first two legs.

## Dependencies

depends_on e7f3-2b45-8d7d-4c68 (umbrella). Cannot be developed until enough labeled PRs accumulate to make agreement scoring meaningful (estimated 1-2 weeks of post-deployment data).

To be brainstormed: `/dso:brainstorm <this-epic-id>` after the umbrella ships.
